{{Top|leg}}
The '''"Mercevian Nagua" method''' was a tactic of theft named after the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Mercevian Nagua]]. It was used when a [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] needed to remain in a building open to the public after it was shut for the night or some other event. Thieves would conceal themselves in a suitable position, for example a cupboard, and simply wait until the building was locked and either empty or very sparsely manned. They would then proceed with the robbery.
